title: `ToolUseAssistantAgent` should be able to take callable as registered tools
body:
### What feature would you like to be added?

Should take callables, such as sync or async functions with doc strings, as tools directly without exposing FunctionTool wrapper. 

### Why is this needed?

Reduce number of concepts necessary

linked_prs.title: Allow callable to be used as `registered_tools` in `ToolUseAssistantAgent`.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves tool invocation and configuration, specifically the ability of the `ToolUseAssistantAgent` to register and use tools (callables) directly, which is a component unique to agent systems.
